deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.settingsHint: Permanently delete your account and personal data
deleteAccount.warningBody: Deleting your account removes your personal data from this community straight away. There is no way to get it back.

consequences.profile: Your profile, photo, biography and contact details are removed.
consequences.listings: Your listings are withdrawn and taken out of search.
consequences.messages: Messages you sent are cleared. The conversation stays in the other person's inbox, without your details.
consequences.credits: Time-credit records stay in the community's accounts, with your name removed.
consequences.signIn: Your password, passkeys and signed-in devices are deleted, and you are signed out everywhere.

deleteAccount.typeConfirm: Type {{keyword}} below, then enter your password.
deleteAccount.doneBody: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
deleteAccount.failedBody: Your account was not deleted. Check your password and try again.
deleteAccount.tooSoon: You tried a moment ago. Wait about a minute, then try again.
deleteAccount.confirmRequiredBody: Type {{keyword}} and enter your password to continue.
deleteAccount.alternativeHint: If you only want a break, you can turn off notifications, or limit who can see your profile under Privacy.
